title: Pressure Washing Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for pressure washing jobs — driveway, house exterior, deck, fence, sidewalk and gutter cleaning. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 7 — payment due within 7 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Recurring seasonal washing (spring / fall) billed per the quoted surface list.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled pressure washing line items: driveway, exterior, deck, fence, sidewalk, gutters
Surface-by-surface itemization — clients see exactly what was cleaned
Short Net 7 terms keep small jobs paid fast

faqs.q: What should I include on a pressure washing invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and property address, a dated line-item list of surfaces cleaned (driveway, exterior, deck, fence), tax, and a total due. Surface-by-surface itemization helps clients verify the work.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
